evidence.title: TM NXERA ACHIEVES NEW HEIGHTS WITH TOPPING-OUT CEREMONY FOR AI-READY DATA CENTRE IN JOHOR
evidence.excerpt: Telekom Malaysia reports completion of the first building's structural framework at TM Nxera's Iskandar Puteri campus, with mechanical, electrical, integration, and commissioning work still to follow.
